# Plugin.Maui.AppUpdate

Cross-platform in-app updates for .NET MAUI: Google Play In-App Updates, App Store version checks, mandatory/recommended prompts, and maintenance mode.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.AppUpdate
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.AppUpdate
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-app-update
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android, iOS. Mac Catalyst and Windows are not primary targets.

## Current release

1.0.6 (3 September 2026). Adds Plugin.Maui.AppUpdate.sln. No API change.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.AppUpdate

Registration: `UseMauiAppUpdate` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I force a minimum version in a MAUI app?
- Google Play In-App Update from .NET MAUI
- App Store version check and prompt

## Do not use when

- Windows / Mac store updates
- TestFlight-only workflows with no App Store listing
